verdicts.subject: OracleDeclaration.epsilon optional
verdicts.specQuote: OracleDeclaration{exprId, oracleValue, anchor, unit?, epsilon} — epsilon REQUIRED at registration (PARAGON oracle.ts:43's law)
verdicts.divergence: Spec declares epsilon as REQUIRED (non-optional) with finite >=0 per PARAGON oracle.ts:43 and MC-A-06 forall d present(d.epsilon). Code makes epsilon optional (?:) permitting register({exprId, oracleValue, anchor}) with no epsilon to type-check, defeating the compile-time brand gate and allowing laundering to 0 downstream.

verdicts.subject: register() defaults missing epsilon to 0
verdicts.specQuote: a non-integer float without the epsilon THROWS OracleEpsilonError (the hidden tolerance BANNED)
verdicts.implicatedSpecClause: PARAGON_L2_BUILD_SPEC.md:695 — OracleEpsilonError on missing epsilon; V443 §2.2.4 epsilon REQUIRED + MC-A-06 present(epsilon)
verdicts.divergence: Spec mandates throw OracleEpsilonError when epsilon missing for non-integer float; code does decl.epsilon ?? 0 then isFiniteEpsilon(eps) which passes for 0, permitting float oracleValue with zero tolerance (hidden tolerance not banned). The normalized { ...decl, epsilon: eps } stores 0 and contentHash serializes [k, oracleValue, 0] masking missing vs explicit-0; MC-A-06 boundary |eval−oracle| = tol+1e-12 → FirewallError never reached for missing case.

verdicts.subject: verifyAndDischarge theatrical bypass || true + void discharged
verdicts.implicatedSpecClause: V443 §2.2.4 |evaluated−oracle|≤epsilon everywhere; PARAGON oracle.ts:75 discharge integer-equality; KB-01:357-360
verdicts.divergence: verifyAndDischarge at 59-77 computes discharged via ((Math.abs<=eps) || true) making discharged collateral true whenever isFiniteEpsilon passes (false || true => true), then void discharged discards it and epsilonEnforced via ??0 reports true for laundered 0. Contradicts spec's |eval−oracle|≤epsilon everywhere; latent bypass survives any refactor that reuses discharged. Correct is Math.abs<=epsilon without || true and epsilonEnforced = isFiniteEpsilon(store.get(exprId)?.epsilon) with presence check.
